name: Bubblegum Cloud Factory
description: A playful sky factory making pastel bubblegum clouds with pipes, vats, and tiny workers.
prompt: A single playful scene of a whimsical cloud factory floating in a pastel sky. Rounded pink and mint machines puff out giant bubblegum-colored clouds through brass pipes, with tiny workers in overalls and goggles. Vats of swirling cotton-candy mist, ladders, and floating bubbles. Bright cheerful lighting, candy-colored palette, detailed surreal illustration, no text, no logos, no watermarks.
caption: Somewhere above us, someone is making clouds taste like bubblegum. What flavor would you order?
